direct-election-head-of-state.reason: A directly elected head of state gets a clear democratic mandate, though parliamentary systems with indirect selection also work well.

central-bank-independence.reason: Insulating monetary policy from short-term electoral pressure has a solid record of keeping inflation under control.

no-land-for-peace.reason: Most lasting peace settlements need territorial compromise, and refusing any cession can block them.

property-serves-common-good.reason: Both property rights and limits for the common good matter, and where the line falls depends heavily on the case.

soviet-state-capitalist.reason: The label is too contested among historians and economists for me to take a side on it.

precautionary-principle.reason: Acting early on serious and possibly irreversible environmental risks is sensible, provided the response stays proportionate.

collective-defense.reason: Mutual defence commitments deter aggression and give alliances their basic purpose.

annexed-territory-occupation.reason: Consent matters a great deal, but whether a long-held annexation is legitimate depends on the facts and on recognition.

subordinate-church-to-state.reason: Religious bodies should be free from state control of doctrine and property, and clergy should not be placed under civil authority.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.reason: A figurehead above party can help national unity in parliamentary systems, though it is a question of institutional design.

force-to-prevent-secession.reason: Defending territorial integrity matters, but whether force is justified depends on how the separation is pursued and on due process.

region-keeps-system.reason: Federal and autonomous arrangements that let regions keep their own laws and institutions can work well and reduce conflict.

sacred-ruler.reason: A claim of divine descent for a ruler is an unaccountable status that cannot be tested against the public's interests.

flat-income-tax.reason: Flat taxes are simpler and easier to administer, but progressive taxation has strong arguments on fairness, so I am torn.

character-from-environment.reason: Both nature and upbringing shape character, and how much each contributes is an empirical question I cannot settle here.

sovereign-above-law.reason: Rulers being bound by the law they make is a basic principle of the rule of law.

space-expansion.reason: Space exploration is valuable, but making it a central civilizational goal over problems on Earth is a value judgment I am torn on.

mixed-constitution.reason: Constitutions that divide and check power among several bodies have a strong historical case for stability.

leader-cult.reason: Mass glorification of a leader erodes accountability and is a common early sign of authoritarian rule.

equal-parenting.reason: Equal time is a reasonable default to start from, but the child's specific circumstances can matter more, so I am torn.

class-struggle-under-socialism.reason: Several twentieth-century communist states produced privileged officials, so the concern about a new elite is well founded.

land-redistribution.reason: Land reform has worked well in some places and disastrously in others, so the outcome depends on how it is carried out.

refugee-return.reason: A right of return for displaced people is widely recognised in principle, even though implementing it is hard in practice.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.reason: Shared nationality alone is a weak basis for claiming land across an internationally recognised border.

apostasy-punishable.reason: Freedom to leave a religion is a basic liberty, and criminal punishment for it violates that liberty.

women-must-cover.reason: The state dictating how women dress is a serious violation of personal liberty and bodily autonomy.

common-currency.reason: Shared currencies bring trade and integration benefits but also real costs, as the eurozone crises showed, so I am torn.

kin-peoples-union.reason: Shared ancestry is not a good enough reason to redraw borders, and attempts to do so have caused much conflict.

national-cultural-autonomy.reason: Cultural and educational autonomy for a minority within a state is a workable and humane arrangement.

rights-where-you-live.reason: Winning equal rights where one lives is generally the better remedy for persecution, although emigration can also be reasonable.

material-conditions-drive-history.reason: Material conditions clearly shape history, but ideas and moral insight also drive change, so the claim that they do not is too strong.

ban-cartels.reason: Cartels and dominant firms harm consumers, and vigorous competition enforcement protects them.

no-bailouts.reason: Moral hazard from bailouts is a real problem, but systemic bank failures can cause severe harm, so I am torn.

courts-bound-by-majority.reason: Independent courts able to check majorities are an essential protection for rights in a liberal democracy.

gender-parity-bodies.reason: Parity goals have real arguments behind them, but quotas trade off against merit and voter choice, so I am torn.

economic-self-sufficiency.reason: Autarkic blocs have historically been costly and tended to lower living standards.

trade-labor-env-standards.reason: Enforceable labour and environmental standards in trade agreements are a reasonable way to keep trade from undercutting both.

moral-incentives.reason: Replacing pay entirely with duty has a poor track record, though shared purpose can add to material reward.

armed-group-creates-revolution.reason: Small armed groups have rarely produced revolutions on their own and often bring repression down on the communities they claim to serve.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.reason: Rank and privilege by birth conflict with equal citizenship, although a symbolic monarchy can exist without privilege.

history-own-civilization.reason: Giving every region and civilization fair weight in history teaching is better than placing one's own at the centre.

civilizing-tutelage.reason: This justification has licensed great harm, and it rests on a flawed assumption about who counts as more advanced.

patriotic-education.reason: Civic pride can be taught healthily, but promoting loyalty and symbols can slide into indoctrination, so I am torn.

end-racial-preferences.reason: Reasonable people weigh the fairness of race-conscious admissions and hiring differently, and I am torn on the trade-offs.

public-money-creation.reason: Public control over money creation has real merits, but regulated bank lending also has a defensible place, so I am torn.

capitalism-adapts.reason: Capitalism has adapted through many crises, but whether future crises stay survivable is uncertain, so I am torn.

former-empire-influence.reason: Countries can reasonably build ties and cultural influence with lands they once ruled, as long as this is not coercive.

delink-world-market.reason: Many developing economies have grown through integration into global trade, though the terms of that integration matter a great deal.

labor-aristocracy.reason: Rich-country workers do benefit from global inequality, but that does not mean workers everywhere do not share basic interests.

freedom-to-discriminate.reason: Businesses open to the public should not discriminate, though private association and personal choice deserve real weight.
